# Checks that an identical binary is built with -trimpath from the same
# source files, with BOLERO_ROOT in two different locations.
# Verifies golang.org/issue/38989

[short] skip
[!symlink] skip

# Symlink the compiler to a local path
env BOLERO_ROOT=$WORK/goroot1
symlink $BOLERO_ROOT -> $TESTGO_GOROOT

# Set up fresh BOLERO_CACHE
env BOLERO_CACHE=$WORK/gocache1
mkdir $BOLERO_CACHE

# Build a simple binary
bolero build -o binary1 -trimpath -x main.go

# Now repeat the same process with the compiler at a different local path
env BOLERO_ROOT=$WORK/goroot2
symlink $BOLERO_ROOT -> $TESTGO_GOROOT

env BOLERO_CACHE=$WORK/gocache2
mkdir $BOLERO_CACHE

bolero build -o binary2 -trimpath -x main.go

# Check that the binaries match exactly
bolero tool buildid binary1
cp stdout buildid1
bolero tool buildid binary2
cp stdout buildid2
cmp buildid1 buildid2


-- main.go --
package main
func main() {}
